mapper.select: select id, scope_type, merchant_id, source_store_id, asset_type, name, storage_key, mime_type, width, height, byte_size, checksum_sha256, audit_status, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at from assets where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and asset_type = #{assetType} order by created_at desc, id desc limit 200
mapper.insert: insert into assets (scope_type, merchant_id, source_store_id, asset_type, name, storage_key, mime_type, width, height, byte_size, checksum_sha256, audit_status, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) values (#{scopeType}, #{merchantId}, #{sourceStoreId}, #{assetType}, #{name}, #{storageKey}, #{mimeType}, #{width}, #{height}, #{byteSize}, #{checksumSha256}, #{auditStatus}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update assets set status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_at = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and id = #{assetId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select count(*) from theme_asset_refs where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and asset_id = #{assetId} and version_id is not null
mapper.delete: delete from theme_asset_refs where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and theme_id = #{themeId} and draft_id = #{draftId}
delete from theme_asset_refs where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and theme_id = #{themeId} and version_id = #{versionId}
mapper.insert: insert into theme_asset_refs (merchant_id, theme_id, draft_id, version_id, asset_id, usage_key, created_at) values (#{merchantId}, #{themeId}, #{draftId}, #{versionId}, #{assetId}, #{usageKey}, now())
mapper.select: select r.asset_id id, a.storage_key from theme_asset_refs r inner join assets a on a.id = r.asset_id and a.merchant_id = r.merchant_id where r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and r.version_id = #{versionId} and a.status = 'ACTIVE' and a.audit_status = 'APPROVED'
select id, storage_key from assets where id in #{assetId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and audit_status = 'APPROVED' and (scope_type = 'SYSTEM' or (scope_type = 'MERCHANT' and merchant_id = #{merchantId}))

select id, scope_type, merchant_id, source_store_id, asset_type, name, storage_key, mime_type, width, height, byte_size, checksum_sha256, audit_status, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at from assets where id in #{assetId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and audit_status = 'APPROVED' and (scope_type = 'SYSTEM' or (scope_type = 'MERCHANT' and merchant_id = #{merchantId}))
